description: Point the live editor's camera at one diagram frame, some ids, or (with neither) the whole page. Changes the view only, not the document.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

frameId.description: Diagram frame id to frame (wins over ids).

title: Fit the view
